audit.why: win[0..6] reads Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Master Yi, Master Yi, Vayne, which matches the packet levelChart exactly (480 games, 48.75%) and matches every whys[] string on the page. No cross-layer disagreement is possible here because there is no full-layer entry for this matchup at all — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item spikes described Highlander only as letting him 'stick through Tumble', with no cooldown, and Wuju Style was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Highlander is a flat 85s at every rank, makes him immune to slowing effects, is extended by champion kills and assists, and passively cuts the cooldowns of his other abilities on a kill or assist — so a single kill compounds. Wuju Style is 14s and adds true damage to his basic attacks, which is why armour alone misreads the trade. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 and shortened by his basic attacks.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the kill-extension mechanic written into spikes[1], spikes[2], mid and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings say Condemn 'hard-cancels' or 'flatly denies' the Alpha Strike engage — spikes[0].text, early, and whys[1] by implication. Nothing on the page mentions Meditate.
audit.why: Riot's text says Master Yi becomes untargetable while Alpha Strike is travelling. Condemn is a targeted ability; it cannot be spent into an untargetable champion, so telling the player it denies the engage sends them to press E into nothing and then be caught with a 20s cooldown down. The correct instruction is the opposite: wait it out and Condemn the landing. Meanwhile the interaction that genuinely is decisive is missing entirely — Meditate is a 10s heal channel and Riot's text marks it interruptible, so Condemn's knockback cancels it outright and its healing is also the reason Grievous Wounds matters here.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], early, whys[1], mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[2] rewritten around the untargetable window and the Meditate cancel.
